newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - May 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - May 22.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Thursday:
* Rebel forces received support from neighboring countries to the former Zaire.
* The Air Force chief of staff criticized the first female B-52 pilot, First Lt. Kelly Flinn.
* Russia's government urged parliament to cut spending on the military and state-subsidized industries.
* President Clinton helped kill a proposal to increase taxes on cigarettes.
* In the fight against tobacco companies, private lawyers representing states are having increased influence beyond what is usual.
* U.S. government prosecutors have rested their case against accused Oklahoma City bomber Timothy McVeigh.
* The Connecticut General Assembly has voted to restrict the power of managed-care companies in denying treatment to customers.
